title: Substitution-functionalized copper phthalocyanine (CuPc)/carbon nitride (g-C3N4) electrocatalysts for the simultaneous detection of 4-nitroaniline and nitrofurantoin
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3731-3746
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00092K, Paper
Nandini Nataraj, Dhayanantha Prabu Jaihindh, Shen-Ming Chen, Amr Sabbah, Saravanakumar Muthusamy, Sumangala Devi, Yi-Feng Lin, Agalya Mahalingam
Functionalized copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) with electron-withdrawing groups (Cl and F) modified by graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) for the sensing of 4-nitroaniline (4-NA) and nitrofurantoin (NFT).
